scope: Real WorldArena wipe20 matched BWM GPU queue v1
summary: The first matched BWM waiter exhausted its 43,200-second GPU wait limit before either official or candidate inference started.
evidence: The immutable queue recorded 361 heartbeats from 2026-08-12T08:04:10Z through 2026-08-12T20:05:23Z.
Every heartbeat kept GPUs 1 and 4 below the required 61,000 MiB free threshold.
The final snapshot reported only 22,333/22,334 MiB free on GPUs 1/4 with active other-user processes.
No runs directory or result.json was produced, so this is a resource-wait failure rather than a model or data failure.
lessons: A 12-hour queue timeout is too short for the current shared A800 utilization.
GPU-wait timeout must create an explicit terminal result instead of relying only on process disappearance.
limitations: No BWM video was generated and no scientific metric changed.
next_actions: Restart in a new directory with a seven-day wait limit and explicit timeout result handling.
